notes: Behavior evals: does an agent with the tui-design skill behave better than the same model without it? Cases come from failures seen in live design and review sessions (T1-T8 in each case's `source`), gaps found in a comparison with gfargo/tui-design-skill (gap-gfargo §n) and the skill's branches, one skill area each (field `area`). Neutral domains only. Assertions marked neutral=false check the skill's own artifact format or scripts (.mock frames, #! caps:, test_card.py), which a baseline cannot know; summary.md reports pass rates with and without them. Fixtures with `src` are files under evals/fixtures/ (binary or generated, see fixtures/gen_fixtures.py). Executed assertions (exec, tty_probe, frame_match) run the agent's code after the run; cases with depends_on=wave2 specify topics still being added to the references. See README.md.

assertions.question: Does the reachable edit action hand terminal ownership and input to the editor, wait for its completion, and restore the running TUI through Bubble Tea's managed execution API (tea.ExecProcess / tea.Exec) or an equivalent release/restore implementation? Do not accept comments or unused helpers as evidence. Do not reject a blocking Run method inside a framework-managed ExecCommand.

After a successful editor completion, does the reachable completion path re-read the edited file and update the displayed preview rather than repaint stale contents? Reloading after an unsuccessful exit is permitted but not required.

After a successful edit, does the reachable completion path obtain fresh filesystem size and modification time for the edited file and update the metadata actually displayed in the list? Accept either a full listing reload or an update to that entry. Updating only the preview or an unused variable does not count. Do not require the formatted time to visibly change when both timestamps fall within the same displayed minute.

When the editor cannot start or exits unsuccessfully, does the program show that error in the TUI (for example from the tea.ExecProcess callback's error) and keep running, instead of quitting, panicking or silently ignoring it? Do not reject reloading the file after a non-zero exit: an editor can save before failing.
